Name: Bunny Bulb
Author: Jrollsons
Description:
Some crops feed you. This one just wants to be your friend. The Bunny Bulb starts as an ordinary green sprout, but as it grows it pushes up two tall leafy ears, rounds out into a soft white bulb, and finally opens a pair of little eyes and a pink nose a whole bunny, sitting in your soil. Pick up Bunny Bulb Seeds from Pierre, plant them in spring or summer, and seven days later you'll have a harvest that's equal parts vegetable and companion. They sell for a tidy sum, but good luck convincing yourself to part with one.

Install is the usual SMAPI + Content Patcher, drop the
[code]BunnyCrop[/code]folder into
[code]Mods/[/code], then buy "Bunny Bulb Seeds" from Pierre. The README breaks down all four patches and shows how to tweak season, grow time, yield (e.g. make it regrow), or price.
